summary.text: There are three plans: Escalating, Standard and Basic. Choose based on how willing you are to adjust your lifestyle as costs rise.

details.heading: Escalating Plan
details.body: Consider this plan if you are worried about rising living costs. Payouts start lower, then grow by 2% every year for life. This generally helps you maintain your retirement lifestyle.

details.heading: Standard Plan
details.body: This plan gives steady payouts that start higher than the Escalating Plan. The payouts do not grow with inflation, so you may need to lower your lifestyle as costs rise.

details.heading: Basic Plan
details.body: This plan starts with lower monthly payouts, which will be lower later on. Payouts will get lower when your combined CPF balances eventually fall below $60,000.

details.heading: What all three plans provide
details.body: All three plans provide payouts for as long as you live. Your premiums earn risk-free CPF interest rates. Any remaining CPF LIFE premium balance goes to your beneficiaries, together with your remaining CPF savings, when you pass on.

sources.page_title: What are the CPF LIFE plans available and which is the right plan for me?

quotes.text: There are three CPF LIFE plans to choose from – Escalating Plan, Standard Plan and Basic Plan.
If you are worried about the rising costs of living, you can consider the Escalating Plan which provides monthly payouts that start lower initially but grow by 2% every year for life.
If you are willing to live a more modest lifestyle and buy less as years pass, you may find the Standard Plan which provides steady payouts suitable for you.
If you don’t mind starting with lower monthly payouts which will be lower later on, then the Basic Plan is good enough.

In all three plans, you will enjoy payouts no matter how long you live, your premiums will enjoy risk-free CPF interest rates, and any remaining CPF LIFE premium balance will be given to your beneficiaries, together with your remaining CPF savings when you pass on.
